# Module `utf8`

utf8 - codepoint-aware helpers over UTF-8 byte strings.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_utf8_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. Vyb Strings carry raw bytes, so these helpers use
byte offsets everywhere. A provider can walk real characters in web content
with `utf8_len` / `utf8_index` instead of assuming one byte per glyph.
`utf8_at` returns the codepoint value of the byte at an offset; `utf8_index`
returns the byte offset of the n-th codepoint.
